title: 备份文件完整性校验：sha256 比对（正例完好 / 反例截断损坏）
expected_output:
=== 备份文件完整性校验: sha256 + integrity_check ===
备份文件 sha256 = 12fe9a31f923d921b8c61b50058840ebbe9e8d4c512149e28529662996581ab6
[正例] 完好备份: 重算 sha256 与记录值一致 = True
[正例] 完好备份: integrity_check = ok , users 行数 = 3
[反例] 截断损坏: sha256 = 8966b2d81ebcd2fa36d80d6c9010bb3317df5d04ddc16d09f002eeba5de1914e
[反例] sha256 与记录值一致 = False
[反例] integrity_check / 读取结果 = DatabaseError: database disk image is malformed
[反例] 判定 = 校验失败，该备份不可用于恢复 = True
结论: 只有 sha256 一致且 integrity_check=ok 的备份才允许进入恢复流程
code:
import sqlite3, hashlib, os, tempfile

DDL = """
CREATE TABLE users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, level INT);
CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uid INT NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL);
"""


def fill(con):
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO users(id,name,level) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                    [(1, "alice", 3), (2, "bob", 1), (3, "carol", 2)])
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO orders(id,uid,amount) VALUES (?,?,?)",
                    [(101, 1, 500), (102, 1, 320), (103, 2, 80), (104, 3, 640)])
    con.commit()


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def probe(path):
    """返回 (can_open_and_check, users 行数 or None)。"""
    try:
        c = sqlite3.connect(path)
        r = c.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
        n = c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        c.close()
        return r, n
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError as e:
        return "DatabaseError: %s" % e, None


print("=== 备份文件完整性校验: sha256 + integrity_check ===")
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p_src = os.path.join(d, "app.db")
con = sqlite3.connect(p_src)
con.executescript(DDL)
fill(con)
con.close()

bak = os.path.join(d, "app_full.bak")
s = sqlite3.connect(p_src)
t = sqlite3.connect(bak)
s.backup(t)
t.close()
s.close()

h_record = sha256_file(bak)
print("备份文件 sha256 =", h_record)
r1, n1 = probe(bak)
print("[正例] 完好备份: 重算 sha256 与记录值一致 =", sha256_file(bak) == h_record)
print("[正例] 完好备份: integrity_check =", r1, ", users 行数 =", n1)

raw = open(bak, "rb").read()
bad = os.path.join(d, "app_full_corrupt.bak")
open(bad, "wb").write(raw[:len(raw) // 2])
h_bad = sha256_file(bad)
r2, n2 = probe(bad)
print("[反例] 截断损坏: sha256 =", h_bad)
print("[反例] sha256 与记录值一致 =", h_bad == h_record)
print("[反例] integrity_check / 读取结果 =", r2)
print("[反例] 判定 = 校验失败，该备份不可用于恢复 =",
      (h_bad != h_record) and (n2 is None))
print("结论: 只有 sha256 一致且 integrity_check=ok 的备份才允许进入恢复流程")
